    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    PULSE is built on the conviction that marketing fluency is a strategic capability — not a soft skill. Every module pairs business-English precision with strategic judgment, brand literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium marketing leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern marketing — from the foundations of brand and consumer behavior to AI-powered campaigns and omnichannel strategy.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — campaign launches, brand reviews, budget planning, crisis response — written for international marketing professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. PULSE reflects his vision: marketing fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and creative credibility.

    Designed for the marketers, brand leads, and creative leaders shaping how the world discovers what matters to them — PULSE is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning attention into genuine connection.
